newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes down led by major issues.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes down led by major issues.

text.p: The Czech PX50 fell further on Monday led by big losses to the index's most heavily weighted banking stock, Komercni Banka.
The PX50 dropped 0.8 percent to 553.2 while the RPIX fell by more than one percent to 1,152.2.

Dealers said Komercni Banka, which fell 71 crowns to 2,472, had been hit by weak demand from foreign investors who are holding back ahead of Tuesday's meeting of the U.S. Federal Reserve. "It was just technical, there is no big demand, the interest of foreign investors is very small," said Karel Ruzicka of ING Barings.
The Fed meets on Tuesday and there is widespread speculation that it may raise interest rates. Such fears have hit markets across the region.
Apart from Komercni Banka, the PX50 was also dealt powerful blows from losses to its two most heavily capitalised issues, power utility CEZ and SPT Telecom.

CEZ fell 31 crowns to 1,031 and SPT dropped 10 crowns to 3,400. SPT and CEZ are extremely sensitive to the mood of foreign investors, who normally account for around half the trading in the two shares.
